title: Short Vowels & CVC Words
subject: Language Arts
description: Sound out short words like cat, pen, and sun!
steps: The vowels are a, e, i, o, u. Every word needs at least one vowel!
A CVC word has a Consonant, then a Vowel, then a Consonant — like c-a-t.
In CVC words the vowel makes its SHORT sound: /a/ like apple, /e/ like egg, /i/ like igloo, /o/ like octopus, /u/ like umbrella.
To read a CVC word, say each sound, then blend them together: /c/ /a/ /t/ → cat!

questions.prompt: Which of these are vowels? Pick ALL of them!
questions.hint: There are 5 vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

questions.prompt: Which word is a CVC word?
What short vowel sound do you hear in 'sun'?
Blend these sounds: /p/ /e/ /n/. What word do they make?
questions.hint: Say the sounds faster and faster!
